props.title: The Ritual Behind a Cream Bath Treatment
props.text: A creambath is a popular Indonesian hair and scalp treatment that combines nourishing hair cream with a gentle scalp massage. Unlike a regular hair mask, this treatment focuses on both the hair strands and scalp, helping improve softness, moisture, and overall hair condition. Commonly enjoyed after sun exposure, swimming, or frequent styling, a creambath offers a relaxing way to refresh and care for your hair.
props.feature1Text: Nourishing ingredients help improve hair softness, hydration, and manageability.
props.feature2Text: Gentle massage movements support scalp comfort while enhancing relaxation.

props.title: Cream Bath Packages in Seminyak
props.text: Our Cream Bath packages combine nourishing hair care with relaxing spa treatments for a more complete wellness experience. From facial care and massage to body treatments, each combination is designed to help you refresh your hair, relax your body, and enjoy more during your spa visit in Bali.

props.title: Creambath & Hair Mask Options
props.text: We offer several Creambath and Hair Mask options using different formulas and product choices. Each treatment includes cleansing, conditioning, and a relaxing head massage, with prices varying by product.

props.title: Inside a Traditional Creambath Session
props.text: Our Creambath session combines hair conditioning with a relaxing scalp treatment. The process begins with selecting a suitable cream formula based on your hair needs, followed by a gentle application from the roots to the ends. A soothing scalp massage helps the cream absorb while releasing tension, then the treatment is completed with a rinse and finishing step to leave the hair feeling soft, refreshed, and manageable.
featuresLeft: Cream application from roots to ends
featuresRight: Available at the spa or through home service

items.question: What is the difference between a creambath and a hair mask?
items.answer: Both nourish the hair, but a creambath treats the scalp as well as the strands, with a relaxing scalp massage that helps work the cream evenly through the hair. At Spa Bali Moon in Seminyak you can choose either: the Hair Mask and most creambath formulas are IDR 165.000 per person, and L'Oreal is IDR 195.000.

items.question: Is creambath suitable for coloured or chemically treated hair?
items.answer: Yes. Creambath treatments at Spa Bali Moon are suitable for coloured, highlighted and chemically treated hair. Your therapist starts with a hair and scalp assessment and can recommend the most appropriate formula from Ginseng, Avocado, Aloe Vera, NR, Hair Mask (each IDR 165.000 per person) or L'Oreal (IDR 195.000).

items.question: Which creambath is best for dry hair?
items.answer: Many guests with dry hair choose the Avocado or L'Oreal creambath at Spa Bali Moon in Seminyak. Avocado is chosen for moisture and softness (IDR 165.000 per person), and L'Oreal for smoother, more manageable hair (IDR 195.000 per person). Your therapist assesses your hair first and can suggest the better match.

items.question: How often should I get a creambath?
items.answer: Many people book a creambath every two to four weeks as part of their hair care routine, depending on hair condition, styling habits and environmental exposure. In Bali, guests often add one after sun, salt water or swimming. At Spa Bali Moon in Seminyak, most formulas are IDR 165.000 per person.

items.question: Can I get a creambath after swimming or spending time at the beach?
items.answer: Yes. A creambath is one of the most popular treatments after swimming, salt water or sun exposure, because it helps restore moisture and improve hair softness. At Spa Bali Moon you can book one in our Seminyak spa or at your villa or hotel, from IDR 165.000 per person; home service adds IDR 75.000 per therapist.

items.question: Does a hair creambath include a scalp massage?
items.answer: Yes. Every creambath at Spa Bali Moon includes a relaxing scalp and head massage. After the cream is applied from roots to ends, the massage helps it absorb and lets you unwind as it is worked through the hair and scalp. It finishes with a rinse, and prices start at IDR 165.000 per person.

items.question: What is the difference between a creambath and a regular hair wash?
items.answer: A regular hair wash mainly cleanses the hair and scalp, while a creambath is a more intensive conditioning and relaxation treatment. At Spa Bali Moon, a creambath combines a nourishing hair cream applied from roots to ends with a relaxing scalp massage, then a rinse, so it offers both hair care and relaxation.

items.question: Should I wash my hair before a creambath?
items.answer: No. You generally do not need to wash your hair before a creambath at Spa Bali Moon. Your therapist assesses your hair and scalp as part of the treatment. Just avoid applying excessive styling products beforehand so the cream can be applied and massaged in comfortably.

items.question: How much does a cream bath cost in Seminyak?
items.answer: A cream bath at Spa Bali Moon in Seminyak is IDR 165.000 per person for the Ginseng, Avocado, Aloe Vera, NR and Hair Mask formulas, and IDR 195.000 for L'Oreal. Four packages from IDR 449.000 per person add a massage, facial, body scrub or reflexology. Home service adds IDR 75.000 per therapist.

items.question: Where can I get a cream bath or hair spa in Seminyak?
items.answer: You can get a cream bath or hair spa at Spa Bali Moon, Jl. Pangkung Sari No. 30, Seminyak, open daily from 9am to 11pm, or at your villa or hotel for an extra IDR 75.000 per therapist. Formulas start at IDR 165.000 per person. Book on WhatsApp at +62 878-6317-5144.
